title: Old Foes Reunite
next_chapter_hook: When the secrets of the imperial dynasty's dragon vein intertwine with Chen Nian's whereabouts, Chen Ji is about to discover that on the chessboard he has been arranging for years, there still lies a piece he never noticed...

text.content: As twilight gathered and crows returned to their nests, Chen Ji stood alone atop the ruins of a broken temple, robes fluttering in the wind, while his mind delved deep into the fragments of the Tianji Record. Suddenly, a suffocating wave of destiny swept in from the northeast, as if some primordial beast was approaching by scent. He opened his eyes, the brilliance in his pupils flashing once before vanishing, then resumed his usual timid appearance—only the knuckles gripping his sleeve cuffs had turned white without anyone noticing. Here they come. The old nemesis.

dialogue.content: "Impressive skills." The aged voice drifted from ten zhang away. "I traced the ripples of the River of Destiny for three days and three nights, yet you're remarkably composed, even finding time to wait for me here." Before the words finished, a figure in gray robes appeared like a specter before the temple gate—Ling Yuan, the former sect master of Tianqing Sect. His aura had deepened considerably compared to three months prior, his eyes shimmering with what seemed like a galaxy, unmistakably having broken through to the peak of Transformed Divinity.

text.content: Chen Ji's mind raced, though his expression showed only a calculated panic as he took a half-step back, resembling a startled rabbit. "O-Old sect master, what brings you here?" His voice trembled slightly, yet beneath the surface, his gaze remained as still as an abyss. He rapidly surveyed the surrounding terrain—three escape routes, two already sealed by human hands, the sole remaining path leading to an even deadlier trap. Clever strategy. A quintessential case of luring the prey into the jar.

dialogue.content: "Have you finished your act?" Ling Yuan suddenly smiled, an indecipherable expression flickering across his face. "Heir of the Tianji Record, 'waste' Chen Ji. I've not come today to take your life." He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gray robes snapping in the wind. "Quite the opposite—I've come to remind you that you and I share a common enemy." He paused, then uttered four profound words: "Heaven...s...Divine...Eye."

text.content: Those four words thundered in his ears like a sudden clap. Chen Ji was stunned, yet his expression remained unmoved. He stared into Ling Yuan's unfathomable eyes, attempting to discern truth from falsehood. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that supreme being transcending all else, commanding the chessboard of destiny. Ling Yuan had actually brought it up himself... Could this old fox truly be planning to scheme with a tiger? Or was this itself a deeper trap? Chen Ji lowered his gaze, suppressing the tempest raging in his heart.

dialogue.content: "You're quite surprised." Ling Yuan approached slowly, each step landing precisely on Chen Ji's thread of destiny. "Sixty years ago, I too was a candidate for the Tianji Record. Do you know why it chose you instead of me?" He stopped three feet before Chen Ji, a trace of bitterness appearing on his aged features. "Because it wanted... a piece easier to control. And I, back then, was too stubborn, unwilling to submit completely."

text.content: Chen Ji's inner alarm bells rang loudly. This narrative was too shocking, startlingly close to fabrication. The notion of being a piece for the Heavenly Dao's Eye aligned perfectly with his previous conjectures, yet hearing it from Ling Yuan's mouth... "Does the old sect master mean that you've already betrayed the Heavenly Dao's Eye?" he spoke slowly, voice still carrying timidity, but his gaze sharp as a blade. "Forgive my directness—why would you think I'd trust someone who's attempted to kill me multiple times?"

dialogue.content: "Because I know the complete contents of the seven hundredth chapter prophecy." Ling Yuan's voice suddenly dropped lower. "Do you know what it says? 'The Master of Heavenly Secrets shall fall by a loved one's hand, with his soul returning to the abyss of heavenly fate.'" He stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, each word precise. "Did you think it only referred to your sister? No—its meaning is far more cruel than you've imagined."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The seven hundredth chapter prophecy—the core prohibition of the Tianji Record, its full contents forever beyond his reach. To fall by a loved one's hand... these words struck like a poisoned thorn, embedding deep in the softest part of his heart. Chen Nian's whereabouts unknown, her life or death uncertain—did this prophecy point to her? To himself? Or... he dared not think further. After a long while, he drew a deep breath, voice hoarse: "You wish to exchange this information for my trust?"

choice.prompt: The intelligence Ling Yuan revealed was too shocking, forcing Chen Ji to decide whether to temporarily trust his sworn enemy...

choices.description: While Ling Yuan's words had flaws, his voluntary mention of the Heavenly Dao's Eye was no coincidence. Rather than gaining another enemy, it's better to gain another variable.
choices.visible_cost: Risk exposing more information to a potential enemy
choices.visible_reward: Gain access to Ling Yuan's strategic intelligence support
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan is treacherous, he will fall into a dead end with enemies front and back
choices.process_label: 权衡利弊后，陈机决定暂时与狼共舞

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly snorted with a laugh: "Since the old sect master dares speak such words, I assume you've made thorough preparations. The junior awaits your wisdom." He shifted topics abruptly, "But let me be clear—if you make any suspicious moves, I'll drag you down with me, even if it means the Tianji Record backlash."

dialogue.content: "Good." A flicker of appreciation闪过 Ling Yuan's eyes. "That reeks of the bearing a Tianji Record heir should possess."

choices.description: Ling Yuan is the slyest of old foxes—his show of goodwill must have ulterior motives. Rather than believing his talk of a 'common enemy,' better to trust your own judgment.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to obtain crucial intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Maintain an independent stance, unshackled by others
choices.risk_hint: Should Ling Yuan be sincere in cooperation, rejection might mean losing an important ally
choices.process_label: 陈机决定按兵不动，继续probing凌渊的底线

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, his expression wary: "The old sect master's words, the junior has heard. As for whether I believe them..." He tilted his head, revealing a timid smile. "Please allow the junior some time to think. After all, last time you nearly buried me in the Forbidden Grounds."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan did not get angry but smiled instead: "Clever. It's good to be cautious." He suddenly looked up toward the distant horizon, "But you may not have time to think now—the Xuanwu Sect has arrived."

text.content: Before the words finished, several streaks of escaping light suddenly lit up the sky, bearing the momentum of rolling wind and thunder pressing toward this place. Chen Ji squinted, recognizing the Xuanwu Sect's unique Xuan Water True Qi—at least five had come, and the leader's aura was deep and vast like an abyss. It was precisely Han Lie's master, Xuanwu Sect's Grand Elder Xuanwater Immortal. Ling Yuan was right; the Xuanwu Sect had indeed followed him here. Just... why would Ling Yuan's intelligence be so precise?

"Go!" Ling Yuan shouted in a low voice, and a streak of gray light flew from his sleeve, carrying Chen Ji as he fled westward. Chen Ji tried to break free instinctively, but found that the force was incomparably pure, not at all like an enemy's attack. His heart was filled with doubts—if Ling Yuan truly wanted to harm him, why go to such lengths? Before he could think further, wind and thunder roared behind him, and the Xuanwu Sect pursuers were already near. Ling Yuan's voice rang in his ear: "Believe it or not is up to you, but right now—neither of us has a choice."

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect pursuers are approaching, and Chen Ji must quickly decide on a strategy...

choices.description: The Xuanwu Sect comes roaring forward, and since Ling Yuan took the initiative, this is the best opportunity to escape. Flee first, then settle accounts later.
choices.visible_reward: Successfully escape the danger, preserving combat strength
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may take the opportunity to propose more conditions
choices.process_label: 陈机任由灰芒裹挟，与凌渊一同突围

text.content: Chen Ji stopped struggling, letting the gray light carry him at lightning speed. Behind him, Xuanwater Immortal's furious roar shook the clouds: "Ling Yuan! How dare you betray the Eye of Heavenly Dao!" Ling Yuan ignored him completely, his speed increasing instead. Chen Ji noticed faint cracks appearing on Ling Yuan's gray robe—those were the price of forcibly channeling fate's power.

choices.text: Watch for the opportunity to counter-kill
choices.description: Though the Xuanwu Sect is powerful, Chen Ji still has cards unplayed. If he can kill one in the chaos, he can establish his prestige and break the pursuers' momentum.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing part of his strength may attract more attention
choices.risk_hint: If caught by the Xuanwu Sect, Ling Yuan may not necessarily risk his life to save him
choices.process_label: 陈机暗中凝聚true qi，准备伺机出手

text.content: Just as the gray light swept past a mountain valley, Chen Ji suddenly erupted. The Heavenly Secrets power he had gathered struck like a venomous snake, accurately hitting a Xuanwu Sect disciple who had fallen behind. The man screamed, his escaping light scattered, and he plummeted straight down. Ling Yuan glanced sideways, his eyes flashing: "Impressive move." But in the distance, Xuanwater Immortal laughed in fury: "Good! Good, a true heir of Heavenly Secrets! Today's debt, the Xuanwu Sect has recorded it!"

Half an hour later, the two finally shook off their pursuers and fled into a secluded mountain hollow. Ling Yuan dispersed the gray light, his face slightly pale—evidently the escape had cost him dearly. Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, confirming there were no pursuers before turning around to meet Ling Yuan's profound eyes. "Now you can speak." He got straight to the point, "What's the connection between Chen Nian's whereabouts and the Imperial Dragon's Veins?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan was silent for a moment, as if choosing his words carefully. Finally, he spoke, his voice low: "The Holy Sect imprisoned your sister not merely because she is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'" He took out a yellowed silk scroll from his sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji, "Their true purpose is to use her bloodline to activate the slumbering... Ancestral Dragon's Veins beneath the imperial capital. At that time, the Eye of Heavenly Dao will harness the dragon vein's power to completely refine the fate laws of this realm. And your sister—she will become the first sacrifice to be devoured."

text.content: Chen Ji took the scroll, and the moment his fingertips touched the silk, a bone-piercing chill spread from his palm to his heart. Ancestral Dragon's Veins... Eye of Heavenly Dao... sacrifice... This information crashed over his spirit like raging waves. His sister, that little girl who used to follow behind him calling "Brother," was now trapped somewhere deep underground, becoming a sacrifice in a shocking conspiracy. Rage burned in his chest like wildfire. But he did not let this emotion break through the dam of his reason—anger solves nothing; only cold calculation can save Chen Nian.

dialogue.content: "Where is the entrance to the Imperial Dragon's Veins?" Chen Ji raised his head, his voice unexpectedly calm. Ling Yuan gazed at those eyes as still as an ancient well, then suddenly sighed softly: "It seems you've made your decision." He raised his hand and pointed at Chen Ji's brow center, a profound light entering it, "The map is here. Additionally, this old man offers you one more piece of intelligence—in three days, something major will happen at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.届时，守卫必定空虚。届时，守卫必定空虚。那是你唯一的机会。

text.content: The profound light entered his mind, and a clear map instantly appeared before Chen Ji's eyes—the underground palace structure of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, guard distributions, restriction formations, all presented one by one. The detail of this intelligence far exceeded his expectations. He gave Ling Yuan a deep look: "The former Sect Master has taken great pains. However—" His tone shifted, "What is it that you want so badly?" Ling Yuan turned around, his gray robe fluttering in the wind: "This old man said we share a common enemy. The enemy of my enemy is a friend. As for deeper reasons..." He glanced back, and a meaningful smile appeared on his aged face, "When you truly stand before the Eye of Heavenly Dao, you will understand." With that, his figure turned into a wisp of blue smoke and dissipated within the mountain hollow.

After Ling Yuan left, silence returned to the mountain hollow. Chen Ji stood alone in the darkness, clutching the silk scroll tightly in his hand, his thoughts churning like the tide. How much of what Ling Yuan said was true, how much false? Chapter Seven Hundred Prophecy, Ancestral Dragon's Veins, Chen Nian's whereabouts... these clues, connected together, faintly outlined a massive web. And he seemed to stand precisely at the center of this web. Enemies on all sides, ambushes in all directions—is this the destiny of a Tianji Record inheritor? He suddenly recalled what Mo Xiansheng once said: "Every step you take is dancing on knife points. A single misstep means utter destruction."

Chen Ji took a deep breath and tucked the scroll into his chest. Regardless of whether Ling Yuan was friend or foe, the value of this intelligence itself was immeasurable. Three days... he had only three days to prepare. The Imperial Ancestral Temple, the dragon vein underground palace, and the sister named "sacrifice." Everything would be decided after three days. He raised his head, gazing at the brightening sky beyond the mountain hollow, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly—a smile filled with danger yet incomparably resolute. "Chen Nian, wait for Brother." He murmured softly, his voice carrying unprecedented determination, "This time, Brother won't leave you alone again."

Dawn broke, and the first rays of sunlight pierced through the mountain hollow's crevices, falling upon Chen Ji. He收起所有情绪，重新披上那副timid卑微的外衣，大步走出山腹。天机录残页在神识中slightly颤动，仿佛在提醒他：命运的齿轮已经转动，无论前方是坦途还是深渊，他都只能一往无前。三日后，皇都太庙。命运的棋局，即将迎来最关键的一手。而那个在暗处注视了无数岁月的「天道之眼」，此刻是否也在expectant着这盘棋的终局？
